page.overview:
Who is Verstael Besithia?

Research Chief Verstael Besithia is a minor antagonist in Final Fantasy XV, the main antagonist of Final Fantasy XV: Episode Prompto and a supporting character in Final Fantasy XV: Episode Ardyn. He is an imperial researcher who developed the technology used to create Niflheim's magitek infantry. His megalomania drives him to produce ever stronger magitek creations in the empire's bid to defy even the Astrals.

Though he has a small role in the main game, he is more prominent in the DLC episodes and his reports and journal entries shed light on the workings of daemons and the Starscourge.

Verstael is characterized by the "mad scientist" trope, following the likes of Dr. Lugae from Final Fantasy IV, Professor Hojo from Final Fantasy VII and Dr Cid from Final Fantasy XII.

Verstael is a balding man with white hair and beard. In his concept artwork and official render he wears a silver headpiece that has the symbol of Niflheim, but he does not wear it in the game. He wears a uniform of black metal and purple and red clothing and a cape. In his concept artwork and early material , his long gloves are white with the red symbol of Niflheim, but in the game his gloves are black.
